name: RC-B10-0175/2025 – § 3/2
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the severe political, humanitarian and human rights crisis in Sudan, in particular the sexual violence and child rape
part_text: and sexual and reproductive healthcare services
part_context: Strongly condemns the indiscriminate attacks on civilians and widespread sexual violence against women and children committed by both the SAF and RSF; urges all parties to stop these horrendous acts and war crimes, including child rape; emphasises the need for supports for survivors, including healthcare, treatment and psychosocial support, and sexual and reproductive healthcare services; demands that the perpetrators are held accountable;
